claim_boundary: This is a mechanical re-adjudication of prospectively generated v0.26 scientific data. It changes no scientific cell, formula, threshold, source result, or original verdict. The repair replaces one brittle prose-substring gate with structural checks over the sealed protocol's prior-art identifiers, allowed claims, forbidden claims, and explicit no-novelty boundary. If every original scientific gate passed, the original failure is isolated exactly to G9, every immutable source hash matches, and the repaired structural gate passes, v0.26.1 may establish the offset-access boundary using the already prospective v0.26 data. It may not claim that v0.26 passed, that v0.26.1 is a fresh scientific run, that the mathematics is novel, that ordinary comparisons expose cardinal offsets, or that ASMP-9 is resolved.

allowed: V0.26.1 is a mechanical re-adjudication over prospectively registered v0.26 scientific data.
The v0.26 mathematical checks may support the offset-access theorem only if their original gates and independent recomputations all passed.
The repaired prior-art gate checks structured identifiers and frozen claim lists rather than typography in explanatory prose.
forbidden: The repair changed any scientific threshold, cell, result, or original verdict.
Classical preference elicitation, bisection, active learning, or stochastic root finding is new.
Ordinary preference comparisons expose known cardinal reward offsets.
